description: This header file declares structures and functions related to symbolic shape caching within the PyTorch JIT compiler. It includes class definitions, methods for cache management, and external references relevant to shape analysis and caching.

classes.name: CanonicalizedSymbolicShape
classes.description: A class representing a canonical form of a symbolic shape used for caching and comparison.

methods.name: CanonicalizedSymbolicShape(const c10::SymbolicShape & orig_shape,std::unordered_map<int64_t,int64_t> & ss_map)
methods.description: Constructs a canonical shape from a symbolic shape, optionally using a map for transformation.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Computes a hash for the canonicalized shape, useful for cache identification.

methods.name: toSymbolicShape
methods.description: Converts the canonicalized shape back to a symbolic shape, using an inverse mapping.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator to compare two canonicalized symbolic shapes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the canonicalized shape with a symbolic shape and a mapping.

methods.name: get_cached_shape_function
methods.description: Retrieves a cached shape result based on a function schema and inputs.

methods.name: cache_shape_function
methods.description: Stores a shape result in the cache associated with a function schema and inputs.

methods.name: clear_shape_cache
methods.description: Clears the shape cache, typically used in testing.

methods.name: get_shape_cache_size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the shape cache.
